sentiment.rationale: The document reports a strong Q3 with revenue at the high end of guidance and record adjusted EBITDA, but the forward guidance for Q4 revenue growth of 7-10% and nights growth in the mid-single digits is not raised above the company's own prior trajectory; it reflects a modest deceleration from Q3's 10% revenue growth and 9% nights growth. Management expresses confidence in continued momentum and a positive outlook, but the guidance is not formally raised, and the Q4 guide explicitly accounts for tougher comps. The score of +0.30 reflects genuine operational momentum (record EBITDA, acceleration in nights from Q2 to Q3, strong US performance) combined with confident forward language, but without a formal guidance raise.

summary.revenue: $4.1 billion, up 10% year-over-year, at the high end of guidance.
summary.guidance: Q4 2025 revenue expected to be $2.66 billion to $2.72 billion, representing 7% to 10% year-over-year growth. GBV expected to grow low-double digits year-over-year. Nights and seats booked expected to grow mid-single digits year-over-year. Full year adjusted EBITDA margin expected to be approximately 35%, up from the 34.5% floor previously shared.
summary.margin: Adjusted EBITDA margin of 50% in Q3. Full year 2025 adjusted EBITDA margin expected to be approximately 35%.
key_risks: One-time $213 million valuation allowance related to Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax credits impacting net income.
Policy constraints in some markets limiting supply growth.
key_opportunities: International expansion: average nights booked in expansion markets growing at double the rate of core markets.
Reserve Now, Pay Later payment offering driving US acceleration.
Services and Experiences: attracting new users, with nearly half of experience bookers not having an Airbnb stay.
Hotels pilot in LA, New York City, and Madrid to fill supply gaps.
AI integration: AI customer support reducing need for human agents by 15%, AI-powered search rolling out next year.
Potential for re-acceleration of core business through quality, affordability, and supply improvements.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management uses phrases like 'another strong quarter,' 'excited to share,' 'encouraged by the continued momentum,' and 'positive outlook for the rest of the year,' reflecting a confident tone.
